expect.title: Road Closure
expect.body: New Zealand often experiences road closures. Alternative routes may take more time, so please plan your journey in advance to arrive on time.

expect.title: Credit/Debit Card
expect.body: A refundable security deposit may be required by hotels during check-in, payable by a valid Credit/Debit card.

expect.title: Car Rental
expect.body: Please bring your physical Malaysian Driving License (English translated) or IDP. Registered Driver required to present a valid credit card for security reasons during the car rental pick-up.

expect.title: Hotel/Motel
expect.body: Due to frequent hotel transfers, we recommend packing lightly for your convenience. Some hotels may not have a 24/7 receptionist, please call the hotel number provided for late check-in.

expect.title: Luggage Capacity
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage for 1 pax as it will affect car capacity & please do not exceed 20kg baggage Domestic Flight Allowances.

expect.title: Exclude Meals
expect.body: Exclude Breakfast, lunch and dinner. Halal restaurants in New Zealand usually open later in the day and close earlier. Please manage your meal time accordingly.

expect.title: Fuel/Diesel
expect.body: Please refuel the vehicle using the fuel or diesel type specified by the car rental company, as indicated on the fuel label. Incorrect refueling will incur a penalty charge.

expect.title: Car Parking
expect.body: Parking fees are not included. Please note that street parking in New Zealand CBD areas is strictly prohibited. Kindly use the designated parking areas.

expect.title: Long Haul Road Trip
expect.body: Some destinations might require a 4-5 hours journey of road trip. Toilet break & Coffee break is recommended. Alternate Driver registration highly recommended.
